prompt: You want to send a course you built to a friend. What are you sending?
options: A zip of the course folder, which is the whole course
A link, since courses live in the app's account
The course and your progress through it together
Nothing: a course is tied to the machine that built it
explanation: A course is a self-contained folder, and Export writes a zip of it. Your progress and your tutor conversations are kept separately and stay with you, so what you send is the course and nothing about you.
